"47b7e499-be75-5994-89eb-47a2f5bdc3dc" :question/problem "Without using a calculator, find the exact value of
$$
4\,\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{16}\right)\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{16}\right)\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{8}\right).
$$"] [:db/add "47b7e499-be75-5994-89eb-47a2f5bdc3dc" :question/worked-solution "Let $E$ denote the given expression. Use $\sin x\cos x=\frac{1}{2}\sin(2x)$ first at $x=\frac{\pi}{16}$ and then at $x=\frac{\pi}{8}$. Each application introduces a factor of $\frac{1}{2}$.
$$
\begin{aligned}
E&=2\,\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{8}\right)\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{8}\right)\\&=\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)
\end{aligned}
$$
The terminal sine is $\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$.
Therefore,
$$
\begin{aligned}
E&=\left(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\right)\\&=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}.
\end{aligned}
$$"] [:db/add "47b7e499-be75-5994-89eb-47a2f5bdc3dc" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "47b7e499-be75-5994-89eb-47a2f5bdc3dc" :question/answer-fields "5186798b-7abd-56e2-8a30-03c4aa6cc884"] [:db/ensure "47b7e499-be75-5994-89eb-47a2f5bdc3dc" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186059672 :knowledge-point/questions "47b7e499-be75-5994-89eb-47a2f5bdc3dc"] [:db/add "250ff5c2-1fcc-5eba-b50b-aeefc4d78e4f" :answer/id #uuid "250ff5c2-1fcc-5eba-b50b-aeefc4d78e4f"] [:db/add "250ff5c2-1fcc-5eba-b50b-aeefc4d78e4f" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "250ff5c2-1fcc-5eba-b50b-aeefc4d78e4f" :answer/value "4 \sqrt{2}"] [:db/ensure "250ff5c2-1fcc-5eba-b50b-aeefc4d78e4f" :answer/validate] [:db/add "fbafddf7-98f4-574e-afcb-9ad4325dcab4" :answer-field/id #uuid "fbafddf7-98f4-574e-afcb-9ad4325dcab4"] [:db/add "fbafddf7-98f4-574e-afcb-9ad4325dcab4" :answer-field/key "field-1"] [:db/add "fbafddf7-98f4-574e-afcb-9ad4325dcab4" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "fbafddf7-98f4-574e-afcb-9ad4325dcab4" :answer-field/choices "250ff5c2-1fcc-5eba-b50b-aeefc4d78e4f"] [:db/add "fbafddf7-98f4-574e-afcb-9ad4325dcab4" :answer-field/correct "250ff5c2-1fcc-5eba-b50b-aeefc4d78e4f"] [:db/ensure "fbafddf7-98f4-574e-afcb-9ad4325dcab4" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "018e9f50-0472-569b-869e-52327dfb3a0b" :question/id #uuid "018e9f50-0472-569b-869e-52327dfb3a0b"] [:db/add "018e9f50-0472-569b-869e-52327dfb3a0b" :question/problem "Without using a calculator, find the exact value of
$$
\frac{\sec\left(67.5^\circ\right)}{\sin\left(33.75^\circ\right)\cos\left(33.75^\circ\right)}.
$$
{{field-1}}"] [:db/add "018e9f50-0472-569b-869e-52327dfb3a0b" :question/worked-solution "Let $E$ denote the given expression. Apply $\sin x\cos x=\frac{1}{2}\sin(2x)$ at $x=33.75^\circ$ in the denominator. Use $\sec x=1/\cos x$, then apply the double-angle identity again at $x=67.5^\circ$.
$$
\begin{aligned}
E&=\frac{2\,\sec\left(67.5^\circ\right)}{\sin\left(67.5^\circ\right)}\\&=\frac{2}{\sin\left(67.5^\circ\right)\cos\left(67.5^\circ\right)}\\&=\frac{4}{\sin\left(135^\circ\right)}
\end{aligned}
$$
The terminal sine is $\sin\left(135^\circ\right)=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$.
Rationalize the denominator by multiplying numerator and denominator by $\sqrt{2}$:
$$
\begin{aligned}
E&=\frac{4}{\left(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\right)}\\&=\frac{8}{\sqrt{2}}\\&=4 \sqrt{2}.
\end{aligned}
$$"] [:db/add "018e9f50-0472-569b-869e-52327dfb3a0b" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "018e9f50-0472-569b-869e-52327dfb3a0b" :question/answer-fields "fbafddf7-98f4-574e-afcb-9ad4325dcab4"] [:db/ensure "018e9f50-0472-569b-869e-52327dfb3a0b" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186059672 :knowledge-point/questions "018e9f50-0472-569b-869e-52327dfb3a0b"] [:db/add "generator" :question-generator/id #uuid "50a21fc9-aa2a-5273-9421-9d7d97a4704e"] [:db/add "generator" :question-generator/script "generators/93/9337de33429f720e400d28159cee11e07a426ad39530af33b9646bd7c5af67bf/generator.py"] [:db/add 17592186059672 :knowledge-point/question-generator "generator"] [:db/ensure 17592186059672 :knowledge-point/validate] [:db/cas 17592186749214 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186749226 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186749243 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186749269 :question/retired nil true]]
